prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Fallback flows during adoption (new_flow) were helpful (+8.0%), though the +10.0% prediction was slightly overestimated.
Interactive wait screen tips (wait_info) were helpful (+5.1%), but adding a progress bar with mascot to the wait screen showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reassurance hints and copy updates at the finish step showed no clear effect.
Adoption step redesigns and new verification screens at the finish step showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimate the actual measured impact across tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.2% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Split Visual Path Selection Redesign: Redesigns the path choice screen into a clear split layout comparing pre-made pets versus custom avatar creation side by side. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion. A direct visual comparison helps users choose faster.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In After Path Selection Order: Reorders onboarding so users pick their pet path immediately after the intro story before signing in. (why: Building interest in path selection first reduces drop-off during authentication.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Notification Alert: Adds a background system notification alert option on the wait screen so users know when their pet finishes loading. (why: Home wait step mean time is 2336s, and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop promptly.)
3: [finish, layout] Centered Welcome & Desktop Intro Layout: Redesigns the final welcome screen into a centered spotlight card detailing immediate desktop interaction controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to pets post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Choose_path loses 23.8%, but previous redesign tests showed negative or no lift.
Sign-in loses 27.1%; flow reordering has moderate potential but requires structural release.
Home step has lower drop-off, but high duration and wait_info changes historically yield positive results.
Finish step loses 35.2% and support noted issues, but layout/screen changes at finish historically show minimal impact.
